description_en: Queries the details of transcoding jobs based on a transcoding task ID
description_zh: 调用本接口根据转码任务ID查询转码作业详细信息
name: GetTranscodeTask

parameters.help_en:
The transcoding task ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68570.html operation to submit a transcoding task. The value of TranscodeTaskId in the response is the transcoding task ID.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109120.html operation. The value of TranscodeTaskId in the response is the transcoding task ID
parameters.help_zh:
转码任务ID，可通过以下方式获取：
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68570.html接口发起转码任务时，为返回参数TranscodeTaskId的值。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109120.html接口查询，为请求后返回参数TranscodeTaskId的值
parameters.name: transcode_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The transcoding job IDs. You can specify a maximum of 10 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can obtain the IDs by using the following method:
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68570.html operation to submit a transcoding task. The value of JobId in the response is the transcoding job ID
parameters.help_zh:
转码作业ID，最多支持10个ID，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。可通过以下方式获取：
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68570.html接口发起转码任务时，为返回参数JobId的值
parameters.name: job_ids

NonExistJobIds.description_en: The IDs of transcoding jobs that do not exist
NonExistJobIds.description_zh: 不存在的转码作业ID列表

items.description_en: The IDs of transcoding jobs that do not exist
items.description_zh: 不存在的转码作业ID列表

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding job was completed. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CompleteTime.description_zh: 转码作业完成时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding job was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 转码作业创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Definition.description_en:
The video definition. Valid values:

LD: fluent.
SD: standard definition.
HD: high definition.
FHD: ultra high definition.
OD: original quality.
2K: 2K.
4K: 4K.
SQ: standard sound quality.
HQ: high sound quality.
AUTO: adaptive bitrate streaming. This definition is available only when packaging is configured in the transcoding template. For more information, see [Transcoding template configuration - PackageSetting]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）.

This value is the definition label configured in the transcoding template and does not indicate the actual resolution range of the transcoded output file
Definition.description_zh:
视频清晰度。取值：

LD：流畅。
SD：标清。
HD：高清。
FHD：超清。
OD：原画。
2K：2K。
4K：4K。
SQ：普通音质。
HQ：高音质
AUTO：自适应码率。仅当转码模板中配置了打包时才会有该清晰度输出，请参见[转码模板配置-PackageSetting]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）。

该值为转码模板配置的清晰度标记，不表示转码输出文件实际的分辨率范围

TranscodeJobStatus.description_en:
The status of the transcoding job. Valid values:
Transcoding: transcoding in progress.
TranscodeSuccess: transcoding succeeded.
TranscodeFail: transcoding failed
TranscodeJobStatus.description_zh:
转码作业状态。
Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeSuccess：转码成功。
TranscodeFail：转码失败

TranscodeProgress.description_en: The transcoding job progress. Value range: `[0,100]`
TranscodeProgress.description_zh: 转码作业处理进度。取值范围：`[0,100]`

TranscodeTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template used for transcoding

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding task was completed. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CompleteTime.description_zh: 转码任务完成时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding task was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 转码任务创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

TaskStatus.description_en:
The status of the transcoding task. Valid values:

Processing: processing in progress.
Partial: partially completed.
CompleteAllSucc: all transcoding jobs are completed and succeeded.
CompleteAllFail: all transcoding jobs are completed but failed. If the source file has issues, no transcoding jobs are initiated and the entire transcoding task fails.
CompletePartialSucc: all transcoding jobs are completed but only some succeeded
TaskStatus.description_zh:
转码任务状态。取值：

Processing：处理中。
Partial：部分转码完成。
CompleteAllSucc：全部处理完成，且全部转码成功。
CompleteAllFail：全部处理完成，且全部转码失败，如果源片有问题，则不会发起任何转码作业，整个转码任务失败。
CompletePartialSucc：全部转码完成，但仅部分转码成功

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding job was completed. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CompleteTime.description_zh: 转码作业完成时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
